name: Mobile Marketplace
description: Candidate profile for the private Expo/React Native mobile marketplace repository. The source project instructions and Mobile Plan 01 describe an Expo SDK 57 application with file-based routing and an OAuth Authorization Code + PKCE client. This profile records source identity and technology pins; it does not certify current auth completion, journey coverage, or release readiness.
profile_notes: The source repository is private; external review intake requires an explicitly installed, narrowly scoped GitHub App.
Repository main SHA was observed on 2026-11-22; baseline SHA is a point-in-time source pin, not a live synchronization guarantee.
The module map is deliberately empty; feature ownership and domain boundaries have not been adjudicated in this profile.
Mobile Plan 01 is the source-controlled execution plan and includes measured backend/auth assumptions dated 2026-10-02; those assumptions require revalidation before use as current operational facts.
Do not infer completed authentication, E2E journeys, release readiness, or production deployment from the package manifest.
